cards.f: Why is BMI unreliable for athletes?
cards.b: It does not separate muscle from fat, so muscular people can look overweight.
Ecto: thin, narrow. Meso: muscular, athletic. Endo: rounded, stores fat easily.

short.q: Explain the difference between health and fitness.
short.model: Health is complete physical, mental and social well-being. Fitness is the ability to meet the demands of the environment, so you can be fit but not fully healthy.

short.q: Give two ways that regular exercise helps mental well-being.
short.model: It releases endorphins that improve mood and reduces stress and anxiety. It also builds self-confidence.

short.q: Calculate the BMI of someone who weighs 80 kg and is 1.8 m tall.
short.model: BMI = 80 ÷ 1.8² = 80 ÷ 3.24 = 24.7, which is in the healthy range.

short.q: Explain how smoking harms an athlete’s performance.
short.model: Carbon monoxide reduces the oxygen carried by haemoglobin, and lung damage reduces gas exchange, so the athlete tires faster.

short.q: Which somatotype suits a rugby prop and why?
short.model: An endomorph or strong mesomorph; a large, heavy, powerful body helps in scrums and tackles.
